confirmedPreIntegrationDefectsFixed.defect: Actual login UI callback referenced an undefined loginOwner.
confirmedPreIntegrationDefectsFixed.resolution: Actual UI uses its existing LoginManager.shared; the fixture engine keeps explicit injection.

confirmedPreIntegrationDefectsFixed.defect: WebKit deletion could preserve older raw text and replay the removed Cookie.
confirmedPreIntegrationDefectsFixed.resolution: Confirmed removals erase matching root-domain/name legacy text with rich/native records; unrelated keys remain.

confirmedPreIntegrationDefectsFixed.defect: Automatic browser request used broad JS get semantics and could bypass Path/Secure.
confirmedPreIntegrationDefectsFixed.resolution: Automatic request uses the same RFC-aware owner header; explicit authored overrides retain precedence.

confirmedPreIntegrationDefectsFixed.defect: An old asynchronous Cookie response or navigation delegate could end a new pooled WebView lease.
confirmedPreIntegrationDefectsFixed.resolution: Real waiter/cancellation ticket and WKNavigation object are captured and checked; only that lease can stop or resume.

confirmedPreIntegrationDefectsFixed.defect: Typed Cookie preparation failure could fall through to a bare reader/review browser URL.
confirmedPreIntegrationDefectsFixed.resolution: Throwing existing-wrapper/source-worker preparation preserves owner errors; bare URL remains only for absent source.

confirmedPreIntegrationDefectsFixed.defect: Expired rich HTTP root Cookie could fall back to stale legacy raw text.
confirmedPreIntegrationDefectsFixed.resolution: Known rich root identities shadow raw text even after expiration; live rich values project into domain reads. Current and fresh-owner get/getKey/requestHeader branches are defined in the existing regression.

confirmedPreIntegrationDefectsFixed.defect: Cookie reader allocated before the size check and could classify ENOTDIR as absent.
confirmedPreIntegrationDefectsFixed.resolution: One FD reader checks exact POSIX ENOENT, no-follow nonblocking regular file and size before allocation; bounded pread handles EINTR/cancellation, checks stable descriptor times/size and successful close before decode/publication.
